exactDependencies: buildProductionAccountIdentityDependencies({ admin: getSupabaseAdmin(), anon: getSupabaseAnon(), notifications: immediateAccountNotificationDelivery, passwordEvidence: unavailablePasswordEvidence, siteUrl: process.env.SITE_URL ?? "https://xeniostechnology.com" })
registrationOrder: Immediately after registerResearchApi(app), before the remaining member/catalog/commerce routes and before static/SPA fallback.
internalRegistrar: registerProductionAccountIdentityApi calls registerAccountIdentityApi exactly once with createProductionAccountIdentityDeps over the canonical Supabase verifier and Supabase store.
gatewayAdmission: Only the exact nine method/path shapes pass the earlier legacy research wall. Organization IDs must be canonical UUIDs. Wrong methods and lookalikes remain walled. The gateway grants no identity or role; the downstream Pack02 verifier remains authoritative.

authBoundary.personalIdentity: research_members by exact auth_user_id; research_applications reused for application profile data
authBoundary.organizationAuthorization: active research_organization_users membership plus route-specific organization role

canonicalComposition.catalog: e858e893e8d877622129a0a2c9b339c2e7a9a697 compatible; no catalog route added
canonicalComposition.cart: existing canonical member/persistent cart reused; no Pack02 cart store
canonicalComposition.checkout: existing canonical checkout reused; no Pack02 checkout handler
canonicalComposition.orders: research_orders, research_order_lines, and research_order_shipments are read as canonical history; organization ownership is metadata only

failureBehavior.initialPasswordEvidenceUnavailable: 428 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED; auth.users.updated_at is never treated as password proof
failureBehavior.headers: Cache-Control private, no-store; Pragma no-cache; Vary Authorization, Cookie
failureBehavior.startupConfiguration: Missing required Supabase server configuration throws during composition instead of falling back to memory or another identity system

notificationBoundary: Immediate existing Resend provider delivery only. The action URL is never logged or persisted; a non-secret claim/invitation UUID supplies provider idempotency. The existing durable outbox is not used because it cannot safely persist raw Pack02 action tokens.
deploymentPrerequisitesNotExecuted: Review, promote, and apply the Pack02 organization/claim schema and RPC candidate through the authorized database lane. Until then account context fails closed because organization access is part of the context projection.
Provide canonical password-specific changed-after evidence before initial password requirements can be cleared. Supabase auth.users.updated_at is not sufficient.
Rehearse the promoted schema and store queries in an isolated database before production enablement.
